title: Rules.
bodyText: The commissioner may adopt, amend or repeal rules pursuant to chapter 91 to effectuate the purpose of all laws within the jurisdiction of the division.
bodyHtml: §412:2-107  Rules.  The commissioner may adopt, amend or repeal rules pursuant to chapter 91 to effectuate the purpose of all laws within the jurisdiction of the division. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
